newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbek 1996 grain harvest complete at 2.74 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek 1996 grain harvest complete at 2.74 mln T.

text.p: Uzbekistan's 1996 grain harvest totalled 2.74 million tonnes bunker weight against 2.38 million in 1995 and below the 1996 target of 4.5 million tonne target, the State Committee for Forecasts and Statistics said on Thursday.
"The 1996 harvest totalled 2.743 million tonnes of bunkered grains," a spokesman for the committee told Reuters.
The spokesman said the Central Asian nation's average grain yield for 1996 was 2.06 tonnes per hectare, against last year's 2.0 tonnes.
The committee did not say how much wheat was included in the harvest total.
Uzbekistan faced a rainless autumn in 1995 and drought in some regions this year, which contributed to the lower-than-planned harvest.
An Uzbek agriculture official told Reuters in August that 490,000 hectares of the 1.69 million ha sown to grain this year in the largely desert nation were not irrigated.
The total area sown to grain in 1995 was 1.33 million ha, of which 828,000 were irrigated.
Uzbekistan aims to become self-sufficient in grains. But this year's harvest is far below the 4.5 million tonnes needed to feed its 23 million population.
Diplomats and grain traders both said earlier this year the former Soviet republic would be a major grain buyer in 1996.
